answer: Reputation-seeded escrow release. Each identity starts with a saffron-scored trust balance that only grows after delivered work, and payouts from a new identity stay in escrow until the buyer confirms receipt, so a clone earns nothing until a real counterparty is satisfied. Because a comet of fresh clones each needs its own completed contract before withdrawing, faking N identities costs N real deliveries plus the escrow float locked at dawn of each clone's first job, making honesty strictly cheaper than cloning.
